_comment: Wand calibration of cam1 and cam2 through the water-filled acrylic tube, run 20261006/T0. Lengths in mm, image coordinates in px (u = column, v = row, pixel centres at integers). See 2026-10-06-plan.md.

wand._comment: From the user, 6 Oct: the wand is 10 mm long (centre to centre), the balls are 3 mm and 4 mm. End A is the small ball.

tube._comment: As in cases/cyl_20260930_T0_cam1/config.json (the same tube, assumed: the user did not say otherwise).

detect._comment: ball_ellipses.detect_wand_balls, the GUI's 'ellipse' mode. Rod settings sized for this wand on the P0 survey (tests/p0_survey_out.txt): opening inside the window 91-101 px common to both cameras; mask about the rod's half-width plus twice its blur (checked in T1).
detect._workers: 48 processes: reading the images from the network drive, not the computing, limits the speed (one stream reads about 1.5 files/s; parallel reads add up).

accept._comment: A camera-frame is kept with two balls apart (the guard), both fits with an edge RMS at most edge_rms_max_px and an aspect ratio in aspect_range, and both sizes (sqrt(a b)) within size_tol of the camera's median for that ball. A frame is kept when every camera keeps it.

reference_20260930._comment: cam1 in the dot-board case cyl_20260930_T0_cam1 (through the tube) and its focal check in air (5 Oct). Compared in T7 only if cam1's lens and focus are unchanged.
